Legacy retains native menus and bundled Dashboard toolbar icon; Safe omits that plugin icon while retaining its saved enabled preference.
Return from Legacy shows XNav and No vessel input; simulation is not silently resumed.
Mode-cycle fixture persistence and clean exits pass. Loopback sent 11 RMC and 33 GGA sentences without transport errors.

No installer or third-party plugin compatibility acceptance
